SELECT r.*, m.display_name AS owner_display_name, d.config_json, d.config_hash, d.validation_json FROM resource r JOIN enterprise_member m ON m.enterprise_id = r.enterprise_id AND m.user_id = r.owner_user_id LEFT JOIN resource_draft d ON d.enterprise_id = r.enterprise_id AND d.resource_id = r.id WHERE
AND r.deleted_at > #{deletedAfter} AND LOCATE(#{query}, r.name) > 0 AND r.source = #{source} AND r.subtype = #{subtype}
AND r.status = 'active' AND r.published_version_id IS NULL AND r.status = 'active' AND r.published_version_id IS NOT NULL
AND r.status = 'active' AND r.published_version_id IS NOT NULL AND r.kind = 'agent' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_listing l WHERE l.enterprise_id = r.enterprise_id AND l.agent_id = r.id AND l.listed = TRUE)
AND r.status = 'disabled' AND r.status = 'deleted'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM resource_tag rt JOIN tag t ON t.enterprise_id = rt.enterprise_id AND t.id = rt.tag_id WHERE rt.enterprise_id = r.enterprise_id AND rt.resource_id = r.id AND rt.tag_id = #{tag} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL)
AND (r.name > #{cursor.sortValue} OR (r.name = #{cursor.sortValue} AND r.id > #{cursor.id}))
AND ( < #{cursor.time} OR (
= #{cursor.time} AND r.id < #{cursor.id}))
ORDER BY
ASC, r.id ASC DESC, r.id DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
